Bedrock Robotics, which makes driverless excavators and other autonomous construction machines, has raised a $600 million Series C at a $4.1 billion valuation. It is one of the largest rounds yet for construction autonomy, a sector betting that the data-center build-out itself needs robotic labor to stay on schedule.
